## ASPIRATION PNEUMONIA
When a larger than usual volume of orogastric content is aspirated,
mechanical/chemical irritation occurs. Some of these develop into bacterial
pneumonia.
It is reasonable to wait before starting antimicrobials to see if respiratory
impairment improves or worsens before starting bacterial pneumonia treatment, in
hemodynamically stable patients.
Therapy directed towards anaerobic pathogens is usually unnecessary.
Antimicrobial treatment is warranted if pneumonia is confirmed.
## Inpatient

## Preferred
See below for prior respiratory isolation of MRSA or P. aeruginosa.
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h [M] for 5 days
< OR >
[Ampicillin-sulbactam 3 gm IV q6h [R] for 5 days](psjizid-pna-ampicillin-sulbactam-3gm-iv-q6h)
## Prior Respiratory Isolation of MRSA within last 12 months:
ADD MRSA coverage to a regimen above or antipseudomonal regimen below.
Obtain cultures/nasal PCR to allow for de-escalation.
[< ADD > Vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h [R]](orz-set-abx-vanco-pna-new-start-mrsa-nares)
## Prior Respiratory Isolation of P. aeruginosa within last 12 months:
Select antipseudomonal regimen below, obtain cultures to allow de-escalation.
Preferred:
[Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h [R] for 5 days](psjizid-pna-piperacillin-tazobactam-4-5-gm-iv-q6h)
< OR >
[Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h [R] for 5 days](psjizid-pna-cefepime-2-gm-iv-q8h)
## Alternative
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](orzid2-gmenu-abx-beta-lactam-allergy-assesment)
[Levofloxacin 750 mg PO q24h [R,DI] for 5 days](psjzid-pna-levofloxacin-750mg-po-q24h)
## Outpatient Preferred

[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875-125 mg PO q12h [R] for 5 days](psozid2-pna-amox-clav-875-125-mg-po-bid-x5days)
